Practical answers

Q1

When is it least crowded?

Late November and February. Avoid golden week at all costs.

Q2

Cash or card?

Cash for shrines and street food; cards are fine at most restaurants.

Q3

Can we do it without a car?

Yes — the bus + subway pass covers everything on this route.
